terms_note: Seller cabinet → Настройки → Доступ к API → token with the 'Продвижение' category; Authorization header; per-method rate limits documented on the portal. Free.

discovery.auth: token (seller API token with the Promotion category, header Authorization)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Wildberries Promotion API in the seller developer portal).
auth: 1. Seller cabinet → Настройки → Доступ к API → create token with category Продвижение (Promotion).
2. Send the token in the `Authorization` header (no OAuth).
3. Respect per-method rate limits documented per endpoint.

reason: Re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium on a datacenter host: https://dev.wildberries.ru/en/docs/openapi/promotion first shows the anti-bot wall 'Подозрительная активность. Пожалуйста, подождите… Новая попытка через 00:48', then stays on 'Проверяем браузер' even after a 75 s wait; plain HTTP clients get HTTP 498 and the old openapi.wildberries.ru host no longer resolves. The promotion endpoints (advert-api.wildberries.ru /adv/v1/promotion/adverts, /adv/v0/pause, /adv/v2/fullstats) cannot be verified against a readable official page, and the bot check is not bypassed.
